title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Draw Order Across Blocks and Overage Billing
content:
## 1. Order of drawing

1.1 Hours for a work session on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours are drawn from the client's active block with the earliest expiry date first and, on equal expiry dates, from the block activated first. The order is read immediately before the draw being decided, among the client's blocks whose status is active, each with its remaining balance.

1.2 When the session's converted hours exceed that block's balance, the block is drawn to zero and the remainder is drawn from the next block in the same order, one draw entry per block.

1.3 A block whose balance reaches zero moves to depleted on the same day.

## 2. Overage

2.1 When every active block is exhausted, the remainder is billed as an overage at the overage rate of the last block drawn or, when no block had hours, at the overage rate of the client's most recently activated block. The overage amount is the overage hours times that rate, rounded half up to the cent.

2.2 Overage in one calendar month beyond that block's monthly overage cap needs the authorized contact's written approval before further non-emergency work is scheduled; emergency work is never held for approval. The month's overage is the sum of the overage hours of the client's overage charges billed for the calendar month, US Eastern, of the work session being decided, up to but excluding that session.

## 3. Worked illustration (hypothetical blocks)

A client holds Block A, expiring 31 March, with 2.00 hours, and Block B, expiring 30 June, with 10.00 hours. A session converting to 5.00 hours draws 2.00 hours from Block A, which is depleted that day, and 3.00 hours from Block B, giving two draw entries. Had both blocks expired on 31 March, the one activated first would have been drawn first.

If instead the client had only Block A with 2.00 hours and Block A's size carried an overage rate of 175.00, a 5.00-hour session would draw 2.00 hours and bill 3.00 overage hours at 175.00, that is 525.00.
